title: Motivation of User-Generated Content: Social Connectedness Moderates the Effects of Monetary Rewards
authors: Yacheng Sun; Xiaojing Dong; Shelby H. McIntyre
eligible_reason: Single common treatment date and nonlinear IV models. The review community introduced monetary rewards for all members at once (mincentive switches from 0 to 1 in week 2610 for every member, checked in the shipped data); the main model is an IV probit of weekly review posting on the reward regime, reward x number of friends (instrumented by circles), lagged reviews and tenure; robustness checks are probits.
design_notes: MKSC_140311_replication_code_submit.do: ivprobit review_dummy mincentive mintXnfrd lagrev1 accum_reviews tenure i.week (num_friends = num_circles); probit on no-friend subsample. No unit FE.
screener_notes: No article text available locally; code and data determine the design.
